signal: Sonatus unveiled AI-powered software-defined vehicle innovations at CES 2026 with partners like Nissan and Bosch, and announced a June 2026 global partnership with Schaeffler to embed its edge AI.

email.body1:
Jason, saw Sonatus land the Schaeffler edge-AI partnership right after the CES 2026 push with Nissan and Bosch.

That much OEM and tier-one momentum usually opens more in-market accounts than a BD team can personally work before the window closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sonatus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for Sonatus.

With new partnerships landing, the BD pipeline tends to expand faster than the team can cover. Most leaders don't know exactly how many meetings they need to book to convert that momentum, so the gap shows up late and the quarter gets tight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sonatus needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Sonatus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatus's reply rate likely compares to peer automotive-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. New partnerships keep a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to an automotive BD motion? I'll tailor it to Sonatus either way.
